title: The Daily Minimum
notes: Outline, stage 2, main quest step: "Set a floor and a ceiling for one thing. Example: walk 10 minutes as the floor, 40 at the gym as the ceiling. On bad days the floor is what counts." Claude's draft.
Runs the morning after Morning Line, unless [Deshawn] already gave you a floor.
Setting it opens Three Days: once a morning line and a floor both exist, any day you keep the morning and do the floor or the ceiling counts as a day of structure.

text: Main quest step: The Daily Minimum.
Pick one thing. Give it a floor and a ceiling. The ceiling is what a good day looks like. The floor is what a bad day still gets. On bad days, the floor is what counts.

choices.label: Move. Floor: walk 10 minutes. Ceiling: 40 at the gym.
choices.record: Set a floor: walk 10 minutes. Ceiling: 40 minutes at the gym.

choices.label: The house. Floor: 10 minutes on the kitchen. Ceiling: reset the whole place.
choices.record: Set a floor: 10 minutes on the kitchen. Ceiling: reset the whole place.

effects.title: Three Days
effects.objective: Run it. Any three days: keep the morning, and do the floor or the ceiling. They don't have to be in a row. 0 so far.

text: Main quest step: Three Days. Run it. Any three days. They don't have to be in a row. The game counts returns, not streaks.
